label: Ventilation
info:
Dry the bathroom out after a shower, using the RAMSES II 22F3 timed boost.
Addresses are placeholders: fan 29:111111, wall remote 29:222222, gateway 18:333333.
Substitute your own before deploying. See the README in this repo.

name: Dry the bathroom after a shower
info:
Two sensors ask for the fan: a sensor inside the shower cabin above 80% RH,
a sensor in the bathroom above 60%. Either starts a cycle; the cycle ends only
when both are below their release points, or when absolute humidity stops
falling, or on the 8 hour backstop.

High is held by renewing a 30 minute timed boost every 25 minutes, so any
failure lets the fan fall back by itself within half an hour.

Payload reference: the README in this repo.

name: cabin + bathroom -> fan
